health_status.forecast: Health Status includes model performance and input feature drift. The worst state is shown.
health_status.anomaly: P99 > Threshold is Warning. P99 >= 0.90 or seven consecutive P99 breaches is Critical.
health_status.recommender: Health Status includes input feature drift. If service metrics are normal but any feature is Warning, overall status remains Warning.

guardrail_blocked_runs.definition: Guardrail Blocked Runs are successful completed runs with no output emitted.
guardrail_blocked_runs.counting_rule: Guardrail Blocked Runs are included in Successful Runs and excluded from Failed Runs. Successful Runs + Failed Runs = Total Runs.
